answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 60028 Country: India Title: The Holy Quran Question: May I listen to the holy Quran translation in Hindi in my mobile audio player? Answer ID: 60028 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1117/1139/L=09/1436) If Hindi translation is played after the recitation of the Holy Quran and the translation is authentic then it shall be allowed to listen to the Hindi translation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
